snippet_primary: "If Etsy is like a table at a craft fair, Shopify is like your own brick-and-mortar store with full control over how it looks, feels, and operates. From the moment you set up, you're not just selling products; you're building a brand and setting the foundation for scalable ecommerce. Shopify gives you the flexibility to design your site, customize checkout, integrate apps, and create a unique experience that customers associate specifically with your brand."
